title: Amelia | Bold striped shirt with vibrant colour-block hem
bodyHtml:
This is the shirt that stops conversations—a graphic masterpiece that splits the canvas into two bold worlds. The top half is crisp black and white stripes, sharp and unapologetic, while the bottom half erupts in vibrant colour-blocking of emerald, coral and hot pink. It's a one-of-a-kind piece that invites you to show up exactly as you are, with colour and confidence to spare. Throw it on for a Melbourne markets run, a catch-up with the girls, or any moment you want to be the most interesting person in the room.

Why you'll love it

  • Bold striped top with graphic punch—contemporary stripes that never go out of style
  • Colour-blocked hem in emerald, coral and hot pink—pure joy and visual energy in one piece
  • Two personalities in one shirt, stripes and colour playing together with real character and personality
  • Relaxed, skimming fit that moves with you all day without clinging or constraining
  • Light and breathable, fresh against your skin even on the warmest days
  • Pairs effortlessly with white jeans, a black skirt, or neutral trousers—the design does all the talking
  • Genuinely hard to find elsewhere—this colour and stripe combination is distinctive and unforgettable

Over 50,000 women have already chosen us, with an average rating of 4.8 out of 5. Your happiness and your trust mean everything to us.
